Description: Found throughout the multiverse, humans are as varied as they are numerous, and they endeavor to achieve as much as they can in the years they are given.
Created by the god Corellon, the first elves could change their forms at will.
Dwarves were raised from the earth in the elder days by a deity of the forge.
Cherished and guided by gods who value life, home, and hearth, halflings gravitate toward bucolic havens where family and community help shape their lives.
The ancestors of dragonborn hatched from the eggs of chromatic and metallic dragons.
Tieflings are either born in the Lower Planes or have fiendish ancestors who originated there.
Drow typically dwell in the Underdark and have been shaped by it.
